messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
我目前無法即時查詢最新的 ATP 或 WTA 排名。若您想知道「目前排名第一的網球選手」的最新資訊，建議直接查看官方網站：

- **ATP（男子單打）**：<https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles>
- **WTA（女子單打）**：<https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings>

這兩個網站會即時更新排名，並顯示每位選手的分數、排名變動以及近期比賽成績。若您需要更進一步的分析或歷史排名資料，我也很樂意協助！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. We have a function sports_team_standing but that's for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for tennis player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer based on knowledge. As of 2026, we need current ranking. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can say we don't have real-time data. We can provide general info: For men's singles, ATP ranking; for women's singles, WTA ranking. But we can't give current ranking. We can say we don't have real-time data.
